scope: 17 core figure prints (figures-core). Written by Claude from viewing each print; bounding boxes are by-eye estimates checked on contact sheets, not measured.

late-edo-utagawa.look: bold black keyline of even weight; flat colour fills; dense repeat patterns on cloth and armour; Prussian blue, teal and vermilion against grey or black grounds; muscular limbs with white highlight strokes; expressive, heavy-browed faces

meiji-vivid.look: finer line, brighter synthetic reds, purples and cobalt; more modelling in faces; either very dense (06, 07) or clean figures on near-white paper (26)

early-soft.look: limited soft palette (pink, olive, tan, dull red) on cream paper; calligraphic line; large open shapes; little pattern

landscape-figures.look: small simplified figures in clean profile; thin line; two or three flat colours per figure; graded ground

shared_conventions.line: every shape is closed by a dark keyline (ink, not pure black); line weight is near-constant within a figure; folds are drawn as a few interior lines, not shading
shared_conventions.colour: flat fills, no gradients inside figures; gradients appear only in sky and ground (bokashi); one accent colour usually dominates each figure
shared_conventions.pattern: cloth and armour carry small repeat motifs (checks, waves, crests, lacing stripes) that read as texture at a distance
shared_conventions.faces: three-quarter faces with strong brows on large figures; small figures reduce to a dot or dash for eyes and a single line for the mouth
shared_conventions.armour: lamellar plates drawn as horizontal stripes of lacing colour; large shoulder guards; horned or crested helmets for commanders; foot soldiers in conical hats, short coats, bare or wrapped shins
shared_conventions.paper: aged cream-tan ground shows through everywhere and warms every colour

palette.note: purple and pink occur (06, 07, 13, 26) but fell under the share threshold; add by hand if wanted

recommendation_for_phase_2.figure_construction: model sprite proportions and simplification on the small profile figures: 12 (runners), 26a-d (foot soldiers), 06g (gunner line), 02e and 28b-c (small melee groups)
recommendation_for_phase_2.costume_and_pattern: take armour, pattern and colour-blocking vocabulary from the late-edo-utagawa cluster (09, 10, 16, 28) and 15
recommendation_for_phase_2.keyline: use the ink neutral for outlines, not pure black
recommendation_for_phase_2.caution: the clusters differ enough that a style LoRA trained on all 17 will average them; pick one cluster as the target or add a coherent single-artist set first

gaps: few true profile figures apart from print 12
foot soldiers with spears are almost absent; the only rank-and-file are the gunners in 06g and the signal party in 26
several strong crops come from low-resolution scans (02, 03, 11, 13, 18 are under 2000 px)
print 27 has no usable figures and belongs with landscapes/palette
